subject: POC Kickoff & Success Criteria — Brightwave Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Park <samantha@brightwavehealth.com>; Alan Brooks <alan.brooks@brightwavehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-12T15:22:00Z
Subject: Recap: discovery + proposed POC scope

Hi Samantha / Alan —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and can move to a scoping doc / SOW: 

Pain points you called out:
- High latency and cost on current cloud-hosted models for inference at peak volumes (telemetry shows spikes during evening hours).
- Privacy regulations for PHI: requirement to keep data in a private / VPC-controlled environment and strict KMS controls.
- Need for consistent generation quality for clinical summary drafts — current hallucination rate is costly to triage.

Primary goals for a pilot / POC:
1) Reduce per-inference cost by at least 40% vs current endpoint with comparable latency SLA for 95th pct.
2) Demonstrate end-to-end integration in a VPC (data never leaves customer network) and show KMS-backed key management.
3) Measure quality on a seed prompt set (clinical note summarization) and target >92% precision on entity extraction as validated by your QA team.

Proposed POC scope (high level):
- Duration: 6 weeks active + 2 weeks buffer for security/compliance checks.
- Workloads: 3 representative prompt templates (see below), batch and streaming modes for real-time summaries.
- Success metrics: cost per 1K tokens, 95th pct latency, and quality on a labeled prompt set (we’ll run evals).
- Deliverables: baseline benchmark, onboarding/runbook, SOW for production handoff.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share a short SOW + onboarding checklist by EOD tomorrow (attached: POC_SOW_v1.pdf; onboarding checklist).
2) Your security lead to share SOC2 questionnaire + any network allowlist IPs we need.
3) Align owners: Rishi will lead integration and engineering syncs; Vivek will be primary SE during the pilot; I’ll manage milestones and billing/contract items.

Example prompt set (seed) we discussed:
- Prompt A: "Summarize patient visit notes into a 3-sentence clinical summary, highlighting diagnoses and next steps"
- Prompt B: "Extract named entities: medications, dosages, and follow-up actions from the note."
- Prompt C: "Rewrite patient-facing instructions at a 6th-grade reading level."

Attached: POC_SOW_v1.pdf, redwood_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Questions / confirmation items for you:
- Confirm the sample dataset format (CSV/JSON) and whether PHI will be redacted for the initial eval.
- Any internal compliance contacts to loop in for the VPC/KMS conversation?

Thanks — happy to hop on a follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

Subject: POC kickoff plan (week of Feb 23) — detailed scope & owners

On Wed, Feb 12, 2026 at 17:03 Samantha Park <samantha@brightwavehealth.com> wrote:
> Marissa —
> 
> Appreciate the clear summary. Confirming items from our side:
> - We can provide a de-identified CSV export of 1,000 notes for the initial quality eval...

Thanks — Samantha — switching to a plan-oriented message below since we agreed on Feb 23 kickoff.

POC kickoff plan (detailed) — dates are tentative and can shift +/- 3 business days:
- Week 0 (Feb 23–27): Onboarding and environment setup
  - Redwood will provision a private VPC connector and provide KMS integration steps.
  - Brightwave provides the de-identified sample dataset and a list of allowlist IPs.
  - Deliverable: onboarding runbook + access confirmation.

- Week 1–3 (Mar 1–20): Integration + baseline benchmarking
  - Integrate SDK, route 20% of synthetic traffic, run performance benchmarks (latency, throughput) across representative sequences.
  - SE tasks (Vivek): validate model variant choices, set batching/cache config, run early evals.
  - Success criteria checkpoint at end of week 3.

- Week 4–6 (Mar 21–Apr 3): Quality eval + user validation
  - Run labeled prompt set (1k records with Golden labels) and produce precision/recall report.
  - Brightwave product team to validate outputs and provide acceptance sign-off against target metrics.

Success metrics (tracked weekly):
- Cost: target >= 40% reduction per inference compared to baseline (measured tokens/USD).
- Latency: 95th pct under 280ms for streaming path (target); 99th pct SLA for canary traffic.
- Quality: Entity extraction precision >= 92% on the pilot prompt set.

Owners / contacts:
- Brightwave: Samantha Park (Product), Alan Brooks (Tech Lead)
- Redwood: Marissa (AM), Rishi (Sales Eng lead), Vivek (SE)

Access & setup steps (technical):
1) Brightwave: create an allowlist-friendly VPN/VPC peer and provide static egress IPs.
2) Share a short S3/secure-FTP location for the sample dataset; we’ll pull into a temporary eval cluster.
3) Provide a test service account for telemetry posting (read-only) and a KMS key ARN for encrypted artifacts.

Deliverables we will produce during pilot:
- Weekly dashboard (latency/cost/trace breakdowns)
- Quality eval report with prompt-level failure modes
- Runbook for canary->production handoff and fallback procedures (will include rollback triggers and contact chain)

Attached I am including an updated SOW draft and onboarding checklist (POC_SOW_v1.pdf, redwood_onboarding_checklist.xlsx). I’ll follow up with a DocuSign link for the SOW once you confirm kickoff date.

If the plan looks good, Samantha — please confirm Feb 23 kickoff window, and we’ll schedule a 30-min technical kickoff (Vivek + Alan + your infra lead).

Best,
Marissa Cole
